Card Q&A.a: No. If you have cards that are targets of this effect, you must add as many cards to your hand as possible.
Card Q&A.q: If the cards I reveal from my deck for this card's effect include both a green Digimon card and a green Tamer card, can I choose to only add one of them to my hand, and place the remaining cards at the bottom of my deck?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. This effect only allows you to place this card and 1 [Gargomon] and 1 [Rapidmon] from your trash in the digivolution cards of 1 [Terriermon].
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [Security] effect allow me to ignore the digivolution requirements when I digivolve 1 of my Digimon into this card at the end of the battle?

Effect: [Start of Your Main Phase] If your opponent has a Digimon, gain 1 memory.

[Main] By placing this Tamer and 1 [Gargomon] and 1 [Rapidmon] from your trash in any order as one of your [Terriermon]'s bottom digivolution cards, that Digimon may digivolve into [MegaGargomon] in the hand for a digivolution cost of 4, ignoring its digivolution requirements. If this effect digivolved, that Digimon gains ＜Rush＞ for the turn.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
